Text: There was once a thriving farm in Biringan...
With your Grandfather's hardwork, it was sparkled with produce, vegetables and fruits, left and right!
It was a place of harmony. And he always had a blast taking care of his plants.
However, a terrible news had struck his farm..
Biringan encountered its driest season yet
Your Grandfather's farm was no exception, all of the water turned into dust.
Without water, vegetation can't continue. And soon enough, all the plant life will start to dry out!
You are tasked to find all the water in your province and put an end to it!
